title: The Things Stack v3 webhook
description: A The Things Stack (TTN/TTI) v3 webhook. Uplinks become one record per device (DevEUI) with the decoded payload's numeric keys as fields. Geometry comes from the frm-payload location, else the device's configured location (flagged lora.locationSource=static), else the preset's position. Private by default.

params.name: lon
params.description: Station longitude (WGS84); rounded to 0.01° unless exactLocation

params.name: lat
params.description: Station latitude (WGS84); rounded to 0.01° unless exactLocation

setup.instructions:
In the The Things Stack console: Applications → (your application) → Integrations → **Webhooks** → Add webhook → Custom webhook.

1. Webhook format: **JSON**.
2. Base URL: `{url}`
3. Additional headers: `Authorization` = `Bearer {key}`.
4. Enabled event types: **Uplink message** (other messages are acknowledged and ignored).

Add a payload formatter that decodes to an object of numbers; at most 32 numeric keys become fields.
